answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, requiring sustained honest service to retain influence; short-lived bursts cannot build durable trust. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned Sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality without reciprocal endorsements from established peers, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits collusive amplification. Like seedlings in a willow garden or orchard, they cannot gain consensus simply by multiplying identities.
